title: OperatorDecisionRecordedData
description: Data of the operator_decision.recorded event: a decision of the operator was recorded for the task in the envelope.

question.description: The question the operator answered; absent for words given without one.

options.description: Options of the answer offered with the question; absent if none were.

answer.description: The words of the operator as given.

node.description: Node of the pass the decision was recorded at.

allow_return.description: The node the decision allows one more return to from node; absent if it allows none.

source.description: Who did it: operator or agent.
